notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Freeguild Veteran.

abilities.name: COORDINATE ATTACKS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 24" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly SIGMARITE units that are under orders that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: UNSTOPPABLE BATTLE FURY
abilities.effect: This unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: ‘I’LL GET THERE MYSELF!’
abilities.effect: This unit cannot be set up in reserve and cannot be targeted by abilities that would remove it from the battlefield.

abilities.name: ITZL THE TAMER
abilities.effect: Companion weapons used by friendly SERAPHON units have Crit (2 Hits).

abilities.name: THE GREAT PLAN
abilities.declare: You must use this ability. Pick an ASTERISM ability to be prophesied.
abilities.effect: That ASTERISM ability can be used for the rest of the battle, but the others cannot, unless prophesied by the ‘Further the Great Plan’ ability.

abilities.name: TEPOK THE SEER
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly SERAPHON units.

abilities.name: QUETZL THE PRESERVER
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons for attacks that target friendly SERAPHON units that are wholly within friendly territory.

abilities.name: FURTHER THE GREAT PLAN
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare:
You cannot use this ability in the first battle round. Pick an ASTERISM that you have prophesied. You cannot pick an ASTERISM that you have previously picked this battle. If you do not meet the condition below that corresponds to that ASTERISM, this ability has no effect.
Itzl the Tamer: 3 or more enemy units have been destroyed.
Quetzl the Preserver: There are no enemy units wholly within friendly territory.
Sotek the Deliverer: The enemy general is in combat or has been destroyed.
Tepok the Seer: There are any friendly SLANN units on the battlefield and no friendly SLANN units are in combat or have been destroyed.
abilities.effect: Pick an ASTERISM ability to be prophesied. Its effects apply in addition to those of all other prophesied ASTERISM abilities.

abilities.name: SOTEK THE DELIVERER
abilities.effect: Add 2 to the Move characteristic of friendly SERAPHON units.

abilities.name: BLINDING CHARGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a unit in this Regiment of Renown that charged this turn. Then, pick an enemy INFANTRY unit within 1" of that unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target.

abilities.name: MASTERS OF ALL TERRAIN
abilities.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to run rolls and charge rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown and to their Move characteristic.

abilities.name: DAWNRIDER CHARGE
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s Dawnrider Lances and Blades if it charged in the same turn.

warscrolls.name: Vanari Lord Regent on Lightcourser
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Lumineth Paragon.

abilities.name: LEAD THE CHARGE
abilities.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for friendly LUMINETH REALM-LORDS units while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

abilities.name: PUREST AETHERQUARTZ
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks and subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: IN THE SHADOW OF THE ETHERSEA
abilities.declare: This ability must be used to deploy this Regiment of Renown instead of the ‘Deploy Unit’ ability or the ‘Deploy Regiment’ ability.
abilities.effect: Set up the units in this Regiment of Renown in reserve in the ethersea. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: LAUNCH THE ATTACK
abilities.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown that is in the ethersea.
abilities.effect: Set up each unit on the battlefield wholly within 7" of a battlefield edge, more than 9" from all enemy units and within the combat range of another unit in this Regiment of Renown. Then, each unit can immediately move D3". The units cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: STRIKE ON THE MOVE
abilities.effect: This unit can use SHOOT abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: SWEEPING BLOWS
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit.
abilities.effect: If any damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that FIGHT ability are allocated to any enemy units, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by those enemy units for the rest of the turn.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit.

warscrolls.name: Akhelian Thrallmaster
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as an Akhelian Raidmaster.

abilities.name: AKHELIAN INSIGHTS
abilities.effect: Melee weapons used by friendly NAMARTI units have Crit (2 Hits) while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: THRALLMASTER
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly Namarti Thralls unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit

abilities.name: SPELL HUNTERS
abilities.effect: While both units in this Regiment of Renown are within each other’s combat range, enemy MANIFESTATIONS cannot be set up within 12" of either of those units.

abilities.name: WEAPONS OF BANISHMENT
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly SIGMARITE unit wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s weapons for combat attacks that target enemy WIZARDS, PRIESTS and MANIFESTATIONS.

abilities.name: GUARDIAN AND MENTOR
abilities.effect: While this unit contains 2 models, it has WARD (5+).

abilities.name: PREPARED ARRIVAL
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is scouting ahead.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up each other friendly unit scouting ahead wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: EXPERT PATHFINDERS
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 friendly non-MONSTER non-WAR MACHINE SIGMARITE units if none of them have been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve scouting ahead. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: HOUR OF RETRIBUTION
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by units in this Regiment of Renown.
Add 1 to save rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown.

warscrolls.name: Stormdrake Guard (1 model)
notes: You can include 1 unit of this type for each Knight-Draconis in your army.

abilities.name: EXTREMIS CHAMBER
abilities.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: DISPERSED FORMATION
abilities.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

abilities.name: DRACONIC ONSLAUGHT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. Then, pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. Inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

abilities.name: ARCANE HERITAGE
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.effect: If this unit or a friendly Stormdrake Guard unit wholly within 12" of this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 4+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit or that friendly unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per SPELL ability.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared a SPELL ability

abilities.name: WRATH OF THE DRACONITH
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Stormdrake Guard unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of both this unit’s and the target’s Draconith’s Fangs and Talons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: EXTREMIS CHAMBER
abilities.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: TOE TO TOE
abilities.effect: Subtract 10 from the control scores of enemy MONSTERS while they are in combat with any units in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: GRIMNIR’S DEFIANCE
abilities.effect: Units in this Regiment of Renown cannot be picked to be the target of RAMPAGE abilities used by enemy units.

abilities.name: DUTY UNTO DEATH
abilities.effect: While any friendly FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY HEROES are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have WARD (5+).

abilities.name: SMOULDERING BRAZIERS
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: WHIRLWIND OF DESTRUCTION
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons if this unit charged this turn.

warscrolls.name: Grimhold Exile
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as Grimnir’s Chosen.

abilities.name: LAST OF THE LODGE-FIRE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target’s Health characteristic. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: HONOUR TO GRIMNIR!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for the targets for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: MOLTEN ROCKBOLTS
abilities.effect: Each time a shooting attack made by this unit scores a critical hit, subtract 1" from the target unit’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn. This ability cannot reduce the target unit’s unmodified Move characteristic below half.

abilities.name: CYCLE MANIFESTATION
abilities.declare:
Pick the Scinari Calligrave in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly MANIFESTATIONS below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Sanctum of Amyntok
Hyshian Twinstones
Rune of Petrification
abilities.effect: If there is already a friendly MANIFESTATION from the list above on the battlefield, it is immediately banished and removed from play. Then, set up the MANIFESTATION you picked within 1" of the caster and visible to them. If that MANIFESTATION is a Sanctum of Amyntok, it must instead be set up wholly within 12" of the caster, more than 3" from all enemy units, and with its 3 parts touching each other so that they form a ring.

abilities.name: ARCANE TAXONOMY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Remove the Scinari Calligrave in this Regiment of Renown from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 3" of a friendly MANIFESTATION and more than 7" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SWIFT ERASURE
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each friendly unit that was picked to be a target of that SPELL ability and that is wholly within 12" of the Scinari Calligrave in this Regiment of Renown. On a 4+, that SPELL ability has no effect on that unit.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared a SPELL ability

warscrolls.name: Scinari Calligrave
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Lumineth Paragon.

abilities.name: REALMSCRIBE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You declared the ‘Depict Rune’ ability
abilities.effect:
Replace 1 instance of a rune on your battle scripture with 1 of the following:
Varinor, Rune of Strength
Ydriliqi, Rune of the River
Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain
Oreali, Rune of the Wind

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared the ‘Depict Rune’ ability

abilities.name: TURN TO STONE
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 6" of this MANIFESTATION. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. If an enemy unit has at least 3 mortal damage inflicted on it by this ability this turn, it has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: RESERVOIR OF POWER
abilities.effect:
Each time a unit (friendly or enemy) successfully casts a spell while it is within 12" of this MANIFESTATION, give this MANIFESTATION 1 arcane charge point.
This MANIFESTATION can have a maximum of 6 arcane charge points.

abilities.name: RELEASE ARCANE CHARGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a SPELL or UNBIND ability for a LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD within 3" of this MANIFESTATION
abilities.effect: Add this MANIFESTATION arcane charge points to the casting roll or unbinding roll. Then, reset this MANIFESTATION's arcane charge points to 0.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a SPELL or UNBIND ability for a LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD within 3" of this MANIFESTATION

abilities.name: MULTIPLE PARTS
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this MANIFESTATION’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this MANIFESTATION is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play

abilities.name: SIGIL OF YNGRA
abilities.effect:
While a friendly unit with a Health characteristic of 10 or less is wholly inside the ring formed by this MANIFESTATION:
That unit is not visible to enemy units that are not within its combat range.
Enemy abilities that would target that unit must target this MANIFESTATION instead.

abilities.name: ROLLING ASH-CLOUDS
abilities.effect:
While the ash-clouds are low-lying:
Units, terrain features and MANIFESTATIONS cannot be set up in neutral territory.
Units, terrain features and MANIFESTATIONS cannot end a move within neutral territory unless they started that move wholly within neutral territory.
Models, terrain features and MANIFESTATIONS are not visible to other models more than 3" away unless a straight line can be drawn between any points on their bases that does not cross neutral territory.

abilities.name: CELESTIAL TRANSLOCATION
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SERAPHON unit wholly within 12" of a friendly SERAPHON WIZARD to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: REDEPLOY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Each model in that unit can move up to D6". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.

abilities.name: AT THE DOUBLE
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a RUN ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that RUN ability.
Do not make a run roll as part of that RUN ability. Instead, add 6" to that unit’s Move characteristic to determine the distance each model in that unit can move as part of that RUN ability.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a RUN ability

abilities.name: ALL-OUT ATTACK
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared an ATTACK ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that ATTACK ability.
Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made as part of that ATTACK ability. This also affects weapons that have the Companion weapon ability. For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from save rolls for the unit using this ability.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared an ATTACK ability

abilities.name: FORWARD TO VICTORY
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that CHARGE ability.
You can re-roll the charge roll.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a CHARGE ability

abilities.name: COUNTER-CHARGE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can use a CHARGE ability as if it were your charge phase.

abilities.name: GUARDED HERO
abilities.effect:
If this HERO(not MONSTER or WAR MACHINES) is within the combat range of a friendly unit that is not a HERO:
Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this HERO.
If this HERO is INFANTRY, they cannot be picked as the target of shooting attacks made by models more than 12" from them.

abilities.name: CHAMPION
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by champions in this unit. If this unit is a BEAST, this ability affects this unit’s Companion weapons.

abilities.name: DEPLOY FACTION TERRAIN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly faction terrain feature that has not been deployed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up the target faction terrain feature wholly within friendly territory, more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

abilities.name: DEPLOY REGIMENT
abilities.declare: Pick a regiment from your army roster to be the target. No units in that regiment can have already been deployed.
abilities.effect: Keep using DEPLOY abilities without alternating until all units in that regiment have been deployed. You cannot set up units that are not in that regiment on the battlefield or in reserve as part of any of those Deploy abilities.

abilities.name: DEPLOY UNIT
abilities.declare: Pick a unit from your army roster that has not been deployed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up the target unit wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from enemy territory. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

abilities.name: ALL-OUT DEFENCE
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: A unit targeted by that ATTACK ability.
Add 1 to save rolls for that unit until that ATTACK ability has been resolved.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability

abilities.name: SHOOT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit’s attacks (see 16.0).
abilities.effect: Resolve shooting attacks against the target unit(s).

abilities.name: CHARGE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat and has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to use this ability. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: That unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so, the unit using this ability has charged.

abilities.name: FIGHT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat or that charged this turn to use this ability. That unit can make a pile-in move (see 15.3). Then, if that unit is in combat, you must pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit’s attacks (see 16.0).
abilities.effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s).

abilities.name: NORMAL MOVE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. That unit cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: RUN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Make a run roll of D6. That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic added to the run roll. That unit cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: RETREAT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit. That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units but cannot end that move within an enemy unit’s combat range.

abilities.name: MAGICAL INTERVENTION
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD or PRIEST to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That friendly unit can use a SPELL, PRAYER or BANISH ability (as appropriate) as if it were your hero phase. If you do so, subtract 1 from casting rolls or chanting rolls made as part of that ability.

abilities.name: RALLY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect:
Make 6 rally rolls of D6. For each 4+, you receive 1 rally point. Rally points can be spent in the following ways:
For each rally point spent, Heal (1) that unit.
You can spend a number of rally points equal to the Health characteristic of that unit to return a slain model to that unit.
You can spend the rally points in any combination of the above. Unspent rally points are then lost.

abilities.name: STANDARD BEARER
abilities.effect: While this unit contains any standard bearers, add 1 to this unit’s control score.

abilities.name: FLY
abilities.effect: As this unit moves, it ignores other models, terrain features and the combat ranges of enemy units. It cannot end its move in combat unless specified in the ability that allowed it to move. Ignore any vertical distance moved for this unit.

abilities.name: WARD SAVE
abilities.effect: In step 1 of the damage sequence (see 18.0), make a ward roll of D6 for each damage point in this unit’s damage pool. If the roll equals or exceeds this unit’s ward value, remove that damage point from the damage pool.

abilities.name: BANISH MANIFESTATION
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD or PRIEST to use this ability, pick a MANIFESTATION within 30" of them that was not summoned this turn to be the target, then make a banishment roll of 2D6. Add 1 to the banishment roll for each additional enemy MANIFESTATION on the battlefield after the first. You cannot pick the same MANIFESTATION to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect: If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on the MANIFESTATION’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play.

abilities.name: SACRED RITES
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly PRIEST to use this ability, then make a chanting roll of D6. On an unmodified chanting roll of 1, remove 1 ritual point from that PRIEST instead of D3.
abilities.effect: Give a number to ritual points to the PRIEST equal to the unmodified chanting roll and do not reset the PRIEST’s ritual points to 0.

abilities.name: POWER THROUGH
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then you must pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. The target must have a lower Health characteristic than the unit using this ability.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, the unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that were in combat with it at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.

abilities.name: MUSICIAN
abilities.effect: While this unit contains any musicians, if it uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make one additional rally roll of D6.

abilities.name: UNBIND
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: A friendly WIZARD within 30" of the enemy WIZARD casting the spell.
Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, then the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved. This reaction cannot be used more than once per casting roll.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared a SPELL ability

abilities.name: COVERING FIRE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that did not use a RUN ability this turn and that is not in combat to use this ability, then pick the closest enemy unit (to that unit) that can be picked as the target of shooting attacks to be the target. You cannot pick MANIFESTATIONS or faction terrain features as the target of this ability.
abilities.effect: Resolve shooting attacks for the unit using this ability against the target. You must subtract 1 from the hit rolls for those attacks.

abilities.name: ACTIVATE PLACE OF POWER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly HERO within 3" of any Places of Power to use this ability.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on that HERO. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following effects:
Ignite Fury: Gain 2 rage dice, then increase your fury level by 2, to a maximum of 7.
Channel Wrath: If that HERO is a WIZARD or PRIEST, add 1 to casting rolls or chanting rolls for that HERO for the rest of the turn.
Dizzying Rage: For the rest of the turn, if that HERO is not a WIZARD or PRIEST, they can use the ’Unbind’ or ’Banish Manifestation’ ability as if they had WIZARD (1).

abilities.name: BEASTMASTER
abilities.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly SERAPHON CAVALRY and SERAPHON MONSTER units for the rest of the phase if they are wholly within 12" of this unit at the start of the move.

abilities.name: REPTILIAN CUNNING
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, if a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘All-out Attack’ command in the combat phase, no command points are spent.

abilities.name: BEING OF THE STARS
abilities.effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for this unit (positive and negative).

abilities.name: SCALY MONSTROSITIES
abilities.effect: Add 2 to the Health characteristic of friendly SERAPHON MONSTER units.

abilities.name: SEARCHING FOR REMEDIES
abilities.effect: Remove each unit in this Regiment of Renown from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 6" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SOOTHING PULSE
abilities.declare: Pick the Branchwych in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Heal (3) the target.

abilities.name: PAIN-INDUCED FRENZY
abilities.effect: This unit’s melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits) if it charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: LATCHING PARASPITES
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target has the INFESTED keyword for the rest of the battle. INFESTED enemy units cannot move more than 6" when using non-CHARGE MOVE abilities.

warscrolls.name: Branchwych
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Forest Sentinel.

abilities.name: SLAY THE TRESPASSERS!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that is within the creeping overgrowth or that is visible to this unit and within friendly territory to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: SITE OF SLAUGHTER
abilities.effect: Pick an objective wholly outside friendly territory. That objective is considered by you to be the amphitheatre.

abilities.name: FINISHING MOVES
abilities.effect:
While each model in a unit in this Regiment of Renown is contesting the amphitheatre:
That unit’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal).
If you control the amphitheatre, if the unmodified hit roll or wound roll for an attack that targets that unit is a 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

warscrolls.name: High Gladiatrix
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Coven Matriarch.

abilities.name: PARAGON OF SLAUGHTER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
If this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
If this unit is not in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: DANCE OF DEATH
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: SUMMON SOULSNARE SHACKLES
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulsnare Shackles endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Soulsnare Shackles endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulsnare Shackles endless spell has 3 parts that must each be set up within 3" of at least 1 other part.

abilities.name: SUMMON MALEVOLENT MAELSTROM
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Malevolent Maelstrom on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Malevolent Maelstrom wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON SUFFOCATING GRAVETIDE
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Suffocating Gravetide on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Suffocating Gravetide wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: CALM AND COLLECTED
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Your Turn
abilities.effect: Reduce your and your opponent’s fury levels by up to 3, to a minimum of 0. You must reduce both players’ fury levels by the same amount.

abilities.name: LORD OF SPACE AND TIME
abilities.declare: Pick any number of friendly SERAPHON units wholly within 12" of this unit that have not used a MOVE ability this turn to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
This enhancement can only be given to Slann Starmasters.
This unit gains a number of stored time points equal to the number of targets picked.
Then, if this unit has 5 or more stored time points, you can pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 18" of it. In your opponent’s next turn, halve the Move characteristic of those enemy units. If you do so, this unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: NIMBLE AND QUICK
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly SKINK INFANTRY or SKINK CAVALRY units that are not in combat to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Each target can move D6". Each target cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: LIGHT OF CHOTEC
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SERAPHON WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly SERAPHON unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of damage points the target has. For each 4+, Heal (1) the target.

abilities.name: THE EARTH TREMBLES
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SERAPHON WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a point on the battlefield within 18" of them to be the target point, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Draw a straight line between the target point and the closest part on the caster’s base. Roll a D3 for each unit (friendly and enemy) that has models passed across by this line. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: EMPOWERED CELESTITE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SERAPHON WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly SAURUS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: FIERCE COMPETITION
abilities.effect:
Each time a unit in this Regiment of Renown uses an ability and any enemy models were slain by that ability, after that ability has been resolved, the unit that used that ability is pre-eminent and the other unit in this Regiment of Renown is overlooked.
Weapons used by an overlooked unit in this Regiment of Renown have Crit (Auto-wound).

abilities.name: FIRE AND FLIGHT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit
abilities.effect: After that SHOOT ability has been resolved, this unit can move 2D6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit

abilities.name: FIGHT AND FLIGHT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 12". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: SIMMERING RAGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: You must use this ability.
abilities.effect: Gain a number of rage dice equal to your fury level. At the end of the battle round, any unspent rage dice are lost.

abilities.name: RAISING THE HEAT
abilities.effect: If you are the attacker, set your fury level to 1. If you are the defender, set your fury level to 2.

abilities.name: ERUPTION OF FURY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with that friendly unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the melee weapons that the unit using this ability is armed with. Then, spend up to 3 rage dice.
Resolve a number of combat attacks against the target using the melee weapon you picked equal to the number of rage dice you spent.
Those attacks cannot score critical hits. Instead, for each unmodified hit roll of 6 for those attacks:
Inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the unit using this ability.
Your opponent must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for those attacks, allocate D3 mortal damage to this unit after the damage sequence has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
Designer’s Note: Rage dice do not add to the Attacks characteristic of the weapon you pick; if you spend 3 rage dice to use this ability, you only make 3 combat attacks.

abilities.name: FIGHT THROUGH THE PAIN
abilities.effect: Before allocating damage to a friendly unit, you can spend any number of rage dice. For each rage dice spent, reduce your fury level by 1, to a minimum of 0, then roll a dice. On a 3+, remove 1 damage point from that unit’s damage pool.

abilities.name: SUMMON KRONDSPINE INCARNATE OF GHUR
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUPPLIES DONT COME CHEAP
abilities.declare: Pick a visible terrain feature within 18" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown. Each friendly unit wholly within 3" of that terrain feature is a target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, Heal (X) the target, where X is an amount equal to the roll.

abilities.name: NO ONE RIDES FOR FREE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly INFANTRY unit with up to 10 models that is wholly within 9" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown and not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield, then set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: LONG-RANGE SUPPORT
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within 15" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown and that no friendly units are contesting. Each unit contesting that objective is a target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: SPECIALIST GRUNDSTOK AMMUNITION
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase, Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit
abilities.declare: Pick Shieldbreaker ammunition or Thunderdrakk ammunition.
abilities.effect:
If all of the attacks made for that SHOOT ability target the same enemy unit, after that SHOOT ability has been resolved, roll a dice and add the number of damage points allocated to the target by that SHOOT ability. If the roll is higher than the target’s Control characteristic, apply the following effect to the target based on the ammunition type picked:
Shieldbreaker: Ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn.
Thunderdrakk: That target has a maximum control score of 1 until the start of your next turn.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit

warscrolls.name: Codewright
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Guild Officer.

abilities.name: ADVISORY ROLE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly SKYFARERS units to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that target for the rest of the turn:
Seek New Prospects: Add 5 to the target’s control score.
Don’t Argue with the Wind: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target.
There’s No Trading With Some People: The target can use a RETREAT ability and still use SHOOT abilities later in the turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the target by RETREAT abilities.

abilities.name: ECHOES OF BLIGHT CITY
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick an objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict an amount of mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) contesting the target equal to the Instability level. Then, reset the Instability level to 1.

abilities.name: Grudgesettlers
abilities.effect: Each unit in this Regiment of Renown starts the battle with 1 grudge mark. If a unit in this Regiment of Renown destroys an enemy unit, you must remove the grudge mark from that friendly unit.

abilities.name: Rune of Stoicism
abilities.declare: Pick the Runewright in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, units in this Regiment of Renown have Ward (6+) while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

warscrolls.name: Runewright
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Kromdron Noble.

abilities.name: Grudgement of the Forge
abilities.effect: Add 1 to unbinding rolls, banishment rolls and rhythmic hammering rolls for this unit while it has any grudge marks.

abilities.name: Settled with a Bullet
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit's shooting attacks while it has any grudge marks.

abilities.name: Thrundok Hail
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's shooting attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is Cavalry or has Fly. Add 2 to the roll instead if the target is a Monster. On a 4+, halve the target's Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Oathkeeper Apprentice Runestriker
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's shooting attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects:
Rune of Sundering: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons.
Rune of Burning: For the rest of the turn, combat attacks that target that enemy unit score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.
Rune of Shock: The target has Strike-last until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Artillerist's Revenge
abilities.effect: This unit's ranged weapons have Crit (2 Hits) while it has any grudge marks.

abilities.name: Tough as Stone
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for combat attacks that target this unit while every model in this unit is within 3" of an objective you control.

abilities.name: Remember Their Names
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit's attacks while it has any grudge marks.

abilities.name: NAVIGATE THE TUNNELS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of a terrain feature that has a hidden passage token to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of a different terrain feature that has a hidden passage token and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SHIFTING PASSAGES
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick 2 non-FACTION TERRAIN terrain features to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Remove all hidden passage tokens from the battlefield (if any). Then, give each target a hidden passage token.
